_what: PROBE — which WCS matrix form siril uses on a dual-matrix header, and whether stripping the leftover form is colour-neutral. Settles BACKLOG:wcs-dual-matrix-inject clause (a) and delivers the clause-(b) SPCC A/B in the same run.
context: solve_field.py --inject wrote the solve's CD matrix into a copy whose header kept siril's PC1_1..PC2_2 + CDELT1/2 (the stack's own canvas WCS). FITS-WCS declares the forms mutually exclusive; astropy silently prefers PC+CDELT (measured 0.25 deg centre skew, registry entry). Whether SIRIL's own read preferred CD or PC decided whether the inject-side strip could change SPCC.
method: three header variants of web/results/aug14/stack_july31+aug06+aug09+aug14_full_wcs.fit, data blocks verified sha-identical to the source before running: A = dual-matrix as-is; B = CD-only (PC*/CDELT*/CROTA* deleted); C = PC-only (CD* deleted). Each run through the exact chain invocation mirrored from spcc_run.py (`load` -> `spcc -catalog=localgaia` -> `save`, sensor-null default), siril 1.4.4 flatpak, local Gaia xpsamp chunks.

verdicts.siril_prefers: CD. A and B are identical at every reported figure — cone radius, 1946 matched stars, both regressions to six decimals, K to printed precision — and their OUTPUT PIXELS are bit-identical (same data sha).
verdicts.strip_is_colour_neutral: MEASURED, both halves: K identical AND output pixels bit-identical between dual-matrix and CD-only. The inject-side strip cannot change what SPCC sees.
verdicts.pc_only_is_the_wrong_solution: C matches 25% fewer stars and its colour regressions collapse toward flat (slopes 0.003, 0.007) — the PC solution's 0.25 deg offset lands apertures off-star; K 0.587/0.856 is a junk fit, not an alternative calibration.
verdicts.bonus_shipped_product_reproduced: variant A's output data sha equals the SHIPPED stack_july31+aug06+aug09+aug14_full_spcc.fit data block exactly (aca3617b46509d59) — an independent re-execution of the SPCC-determinism claim, and proof the shipped product was built through the CD path.
verdicts.bonus_spcc_resave_is_single_form: siril's save writes PC+CDELT (converted from the CD it used) with the known RA---TAN-SIP label — so _spcc products are single-form already; only _wcs products carried the dual matrices.

acted_on: solve_field.inject() now strips PC*/CDELT*/CROTA* when writing the CD (the standards form: one matrix, the solve's), and the existing *_wcs.fit products were backfilled the same way, data blocks verified sha-unchanged per file. spcc_cone.py retains its in-memory strip for any pre-backfill or archived file.
scratch: sessions/aug14/work/wcsprobe/ (gitignored) held the variants; the three spcc_*.log files and .ssf remain there, the ~580 MB fits copies were deleted after this record landed.
